package domain

type StudentPracticeTaskWorkspaceState struct {
	ActivePartID *string `json:"active_part_id,omitempty"`
}

type StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson struct {
	LessonID          string   `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID          string   `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Requirement       string   `json:"requirement"`
	SortOrder         int      `json:"sort_order"`
	StepTitle         string   `json:"step_title,omitempty"`
	StepInstructions  string   `json:"step_instructions,omitempty"`
	RequiredSkillTags []string `json:"required_skill_tags"`
	Completed         bool     `json:"completed"`
}

type StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone struct {
	ID                             string                             `json:"id"`
	StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID string                             `json:"student_practice_task_milestone_id"`
	PracticeTaskMilestoneID        string                             `json:"practice_task_milestone_id"`
	PracticeTaskPartID             string                             `json:"practice_task_part_id"`
	ParentPartMilestoneID          *string                            `json:"parent_part_milestone_id,omitempty"`
	MilestoneKindCode              string                             `json:"milestone_kind_code"`
	StackCode                      string                             `json:"stack_code"`
	StackCodes                     []string                           `json:"stack_codes"`
	Title                          string                             `json:"title"`
	Description                    *string                            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	SortOrder                      int                                `json:"sort_order"`
	Status                         string                             `json:"status"`
	BlockingReason                 string                             `json:"blocking_reason,omitempty"`
	Prerequisites                  MilestonePrerequisites             `json:"prerequisites"`
	LessonBindings                 []PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding `json:"lesson_bindings,omitempty"`
	ValidationResult               *ValidationRunResult               `json:"validation_result,omitempty"`
	ValidationIssues               []ValidationRunIssue               `json:"validation_issues,omitempty"`
}

type StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle struct {
	StudentPracticeTask StudentPracticeTask                `json:"student_practice_task"`
	Part                PracticeTaskPart                   `json:"part"`
	Status              string                             `json:"status"`
	RuntimeTaskID       string                             `json:"runtime_task_id,omitempty"`
	RuntimeLessonID     string                             `json:"runtime_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	OpenURL             string                             `json:"open_url,omitempty"`
	Access              MilestoneAccess                    `json:"access"`
	Lessons             []StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson    `json:"lessons"`
	Milestones          []StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone `json:"milestones"`
	Artifacts           []StudentPracticeTaskArtifact      `json:"artifacts,omitempty"`
}

type RuntimeOpenPartResult struct {
	StudentPracticeTaskID string          `json:"student_practice_task_id"`
	PracticeTaskPartID    string          `json:"practice_task_part_id"`
	TaskID                string          `json:"task_id"`
	LessonID              string          `json:"lesson_id"`
	OpenURL               string          `json:"open_url"`
	Access                MilestoneAccess `json:"access"`
}

type StudentPracticeTaskPartValidation struct {
	Bundle StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle `json:"bundle"`
	Result ValidationRunResult           `json:"result"`
}
